provision.quote: passed under Section 73 of the U.P. Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

date.quote: challenging the order dated 29.04.2024 passed under Section 73

events.quote: Present petition has been filed challenging the order dated 29.04.2024 passed under Section 73
as well as the order dated 01.04.2025 whereby the appeal was dismissed as being beyond limitation.

defects_argued.quote: Since the aforesaid dictum is applicable in the present facts and circumstances, accordingly, the impugned orders cannot be sustained and the orders dated 29.04.2024 & 01.04.2025 are accordingly quashed.
Apart from not providing any opportunity, the order is also violative of Section 75(7) of the Act of 2017.

outcome.quote: With the aforesaid, the present petition is allowed.
